title: Schedule upsert
description: POST /schedules body: one operator-owned batch-run schedule, keyed on slug (derived from name when omitted). Guarded by internal/publish/schedules_test.go.

slug.description: Stable key; defaults to the slugified name.

times.description: Wall-clock fire times (executor-local timezone); the server dedupes and sorts them.

weekdays.description: 0=Sunday..6. Required non-empty for a weekly cadence, ignored otherwise.

monthdays.description: Required non-empty for a monthly cadence, ignored otherwise.

authors.description: Optional author-handle filter; empty means every author with a beat.
